title: Preference Learning for AI Alignment: a Causal Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating confounding effects by artificially correlating user-specific evaluation objectives (helpfulness vs. harmlessness) with the types of prompts generated using the HH-RLHF dataset, and assessing reward model generalization on inconsistent out-of-distribution examples.

Varying the training-time correlation between latent response factors (truthfulness and instruction-following) using the UltraFeedback dataset to evaluate the robustness of reward models when tested on out-of-distribution data where the correlation no longer holds.
